name: normbeleg
description: Connects Claude to the Normbeleg MCP server: validate and explain EU e-invoices (XRechnung, EN 16931, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, RO e-Factura CIUS-RO, schema check of Polish KSeF FA(3)), create e-invoice XML and look up e-invoicing mandates. Two tools work without an account. Technical checks, not tax or legal advice.
